node.statement: At amplification n, Phi_assoc1 from lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit is precisely ||Phi_n(Phi_n(Phi_n(U)Phi_n(V))Phi_n(W))-Phi_n(Phi_n(U)Phi_n(V)Phi_n(W))||<=10eta||U||||V||||W|| whenever eta<1/4. Substitute U=Delta_n X, V=Delta_n Y, W=Delta_n Z. The two displayed terms are P2 and P1 respectively, while UCP contractivity gives ||U||||V||||W||<=||X||||Y||||Z||; symmetry of norm under sign reversal yields the claimed comparison.
